programs.name: NC Home Advantage Mortgage with 3% DPA

amount.text: up to 3% of the first mortgage loan amount

programs.repayment: 15-year deferred/forgiven subordinate lien: deferred for 10 years, forgiven 20% a year at the end of years 11 to 15; due only on sale or refinance before year 15
programs.education: required if all borrowers are first-time buyers
programs.sourceTitle: NC Home Advantage Mortgage Program Guide, July 2026
programs.quote: The DPA is deferred for the first 10 years and forgiven by 20% each year at the end of years 11 through 15.

programs.name: NC 1st Home Advantage Down Payment
programs.firstTimeNote: first-time buyers, qualifying veterans or buyers in Qualified Census Tracts

incomeLimit.text: IRS and HUD limits by county and family size
